title: BiggerToolsPack
description: A 16x texture pack(resource pack) that redesigns tools and weapons with bold, bigger, and stronger-looking textures while keeping a clean vanilla style.
body:
This resource pack overhauls every vanilla tool with **bold, oversized, and power-focused** textures.
_Swords, pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, and spears_ are redesigned to feel **heavier, stronger, and more impactful** while staying true to Minecraft’s vanilla style.
**No gameplay changes** — just a sharper, more powerful visual experience.
